LESSON: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS 1/

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Book handling Skills 1/

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Book handling Skills 1/
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we arrange Skills (1 1/2HRS) learner should be able to: demonstrates how to turn pages books on shelves?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise Book handling Skills 1/
2. use Book handling Skills 1/ in clear sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Book handling Skills 1/

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Book handling Skills 1/

Teach
• Focus skill: Book handling Skills 1/.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Book handling Skills 1/.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Book handling Skills 1/
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we arrange Skills (1 1/2HRS) learner should be able to: demonstrates how to turn pages books on shelves?
2. what ways do learners a) Demonstrate how to handle books • Learners could be encouraged to mishandle books?
3. How do we take care of b) Enjoy participating in book right as demonstrated. books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
